chromeRegression.command: XUNJIE_XJ_DEV_URL=isolated-native-product XUNJIE_E2E_BROWSER_CHANNEL=chrome npm exec -w @xunjie/web -- playwright test worksEditor.spec.ts --headed --workers=1

includedFixes.summary: wait for restart gates before reporting readiness
includedFixes.before: runtime.start() returned ready while maintenance gates were still closed; the first request after restart returned 503 maintenance (reproduced 10/10)
includedFixes.after: initialized only after restart/recovery gates reopen; 10/10 restarts return ready and serve 200

includedFixes.summary: attach the editor model before the textarea accepts input
includedFixes.before: Monaco hidden textarea was focusable before model/original history existed; early keystrokes were silently lost
includedFixes.after: model and original history attach before readiness; the failed-navigation E2E waits for the real failure and completed action

includedFixes.summary: use the installed Chrome user agent in E2E
includedFixes.before: devices['Desktop Chrome'] carried a Windows UA on macOS Chrome and duplicated Monaco hidden-textarea input
includedFixes.after: XUNJIE_E2E_BROWSER_CHANNEL=chrome clears the spoofed UA; all 15 regressions pass

includedFixes.summary: keep the requested activity across context recovery
includedFixes.before: when the first context request failed, a URL-requested activity was cleared by the recovery poll and lost
includedFixes.after: the requested activity survives recovery; deep links reopen after transient context failure

includedFixes.summary: read the latest open activity during context recovery
includedFixes.before: a recovery poll could finish after an activity opened and still clear it, briefly returning to the catalogue
includedFixes.after: the poll reads the current view; the activity is reopened after recovery (a brief list render during the refetch remains possible)

includedFixes.summary: report starting when a status probe predates readiness
includedFixes.before: start() returned failed with 'PostgreSQL startup is in progress' when a probe began before initialization and the flag flipped mid-call (observed in acceptance run)
includedFixes.after: that call reports starting, the CLI retries, and 10/10 restart stress tests return ready
